entries.title: A paused batch waits for its own fix
entries.body: A change marked as the fix for an earlier pause no longer ends a later one, so the queue stops running the same failing changes again with no repair. A fix now ends a pause only when it was marked after that pause began. Your first mate offers a project's queue the update.
entries.noPicture: This changes when a project's queue ends a pause, not any screen in the app.
